title: Do you really need a 4-year degree to build a career in Mass.?
author: Pattie Hunt Sinacole
bullets: Massachusetts employers emphasize skills over degrees, with tech companies like Google hiring workers without a 4-year degree.
Healthcare and skilled trades, with roles like medical assistants and electricians, do not require a bachelor's degree and are in demand.
Massachusetts offers alternative education paths, such as community college certificates and vocational training, often without requiring a 4-year degree.

title: Mike Vrabel: Drake Maye is not expected to play in preseason opener
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Patriots quarterback Drake Maye not expected to play against Colts in preseason opener, Mike Vrabel announced.
Maye and other starters participated in joint practice with Colts, allowing rest during full-contact games.
Patriots plan to give depth chart players more game time in the absence of starters like Maye.

title: Seth Meyers runs Martha’s Vineyard road race with his son
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Seth Meyers and son Ashe Meyers participated in the Chilmark Road Race 5K on Martha's Vineyard.
Seth Meyers finished fifth in his division with an average pace of 7:30 miles.
Meyers, a frequent Martha's Vineyard visitor, owns a home in Chilmark and was married there in 2013.

title: Explaining the controversy that caused a lengthy delay in the Red Sox-Blue Jays game
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: The Red Sox-Blue Jays game was delayed due to confusion over an apparent 'fourth out' during the seventh inning.
A scoreboard error led Red Sox runners to incorrectly believe there were two outs, causing a chaotic play.
The umpire determined a run should count due to the 'fourth out' rule, despite Blue Jays' unsuccessful appeal.

title: Bicyclist taken to hospital by helicopter after crash with vehicle in North Andover
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A bicyclist was seriously injured in a crash with a vehicle in North Andover on Monday afternoon.
The incident occurred around 4 p.m. near 100 Turnpike St., and the cyclist was airlifted to a trauma center.
The vehicle's driver was not injured, and the crash is under investigation by local authorities.

title: This new board game turns the MBTA experience into a game
author: Gwen Egan
bullets: Michelle Dundek created 'Mass Transit,' a board game mimicking Boston's MBTA experience, drawing from her seven years riding the T.
The game's objective is to collect cards while navigating unexpected challenges, similar to real-life experiences on Boston's subway.
'Mass Transit' gained popularity after a video walkthrough went viral, reaching 337,000 views, leading to high demand and sellouts.

title: Suspicious death investigation underway at N.H. mobile home park
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: A suspicious death is being investigated at Hilltop Manor mobile home park in Whitefield, New Hampshire.
Three family members suffered injuries, with one man later dying at a local hospital, according to officials.
New Hampshire State Police's major crime unit and Attorney General John Formella's office are leading the investigation.

title: Livestream: Lindsay Clancy murder trial continues with more testimony from psychiatric NP
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Psychiatric NP Julie Paul testified about Lindsay Clancy's anxiety and treatment with Prozac; Clancy reported feeling disconnected.
Defense seeks testimony from a social worker about McLean Hospital conditions, citing concerns of biased portrayal by prosecutors.
Clancy, charged with murdering her three children, pleads not guilty due to postpartum mental illness and auditory hallucinations.

title: Local obituary: Max Rothschild, Williamstown 7-year-old
author: Boston.com Staff
bullets: Max Curtis Rothschild, age 7, died after being hit by a car while riding his bike on August 7.
Max was known for his love of math, chess, and adventure activities like skiing and swimming.
Funeral services for Max Rothschild will be held at Congregation Beth Israel in North Adams, MA, on August 11.

title: Former ‘Real Housewives’ star Dorinda Medley lists part of her Berkshires estate, Bluestone Manor
author: Megan Johnson
bullets: Dorinda Medley is selling 3.7 acres of her Berkshire estate, Bluestone Manor, for $1.2 million.
The land features private entry, rolling meadows, woodlands, and mountain views, located near Great Barrington.
Medley decided to sell to downsize and reduce excess land she isn't using, with no impact on her lifestyle.
